Use case: stylized-concept. Production portrait4:5travel puzzle PAINTED CLEAN BACKGROUND. Scene: A colourful tide pool between warm coastal rocks. View: gently elevated three-quarter view. Polished warm storybook digital painting matching the approved Art Direction V2 game boards: tactile softly brushed surfaces, gentle sunlight, dimensional illustrated objects, clean local colour separation and rich small discoveries. No flat vector art, no photographic collage, no generic geometric filler. Dominant main colour: soft violet (#AE92C6), clearly occupying the largest coherent surfaces, with balanced contrasting details. Composition is generic travel subject matter; NO recognizable destination landmarks, city names, signs, letters or logos. No UI or border. This is a finished clean plate for five separately painted motion details. Paint complete underlying surfaces at all five declared positions; do not draw the five named foreground details, leave no transparent hole or blank placeholder. Portrait master1280x1600. Part placements for later composition: a soft near-water reflection patch at normalised rect [0.14, 0.62, 0.25, 0.14]; a second distinct water reflection patch at normalised rect [0.51, 0.71, 0.27, 0.12]; a shore reed or sea-grass cluster at normalised rect [0.75, 0.53, 0.17, 0.24]; a softly painted near cloud at normalised rect [0.12, 0.1, 0.24, 0.14]; a softly painted far cloud or spray wisp appropriate to the scene at normalised rect [0.58, 0.18, 0.24, 0.12]. The painting must remain attractive and complete underneath those parts.
MANDATORY FULLY OPAQUE RGB painting, alpha255 at every pixel, no transparency. Actual scene refinement: A close colourful tide pool among smooth warm coastal rocks, SOFT VIOLET water/reflections dominate most of the composition. Subtle purple sea anemones and a few tiny natural shells under clear still water, violet seaweed around edges, warm pale stones as accents, no geometric rainbow glow. A small distant lavender sea strip, soft evening light. No recognizable coast, building, people, text or huge animals. Tactile softly brushed storybook painting, clear natural anatomy and textures. Clean complete underlying water for two separately animated small reflection patches. Portrait4:5, no UI or border.
